target: acceptance 7 — the build skill's Red Gate step must say exit 4 is NOT a valid red and exit 1 IS, in separate bullets. Substring co-occurrence is not enough: blind review demonstrated the prior version passing on text asserting the opposite.
cmd: f="$PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/build/SKILL.md"; four=$(grep -A4 -- "\*\*exit 4\*\*" "$f" | tr "\n" " "); one=$(grep -A2 -- "\*\*exit 1\*\*" "$f" | tr "\n" " "); four_neg=$(printf "%s" "$four" | grep -ci "not .\{0,40\}\(valid\|red gate\|red\)"); one_pos=$(printf "%s" "$one" | grep -ci "red you want\|proceed"); four_bad=$(printf "%s" "$four" | grep -ci "proceed"); bullets=$(grep -c -- "\*\*exit [014]\*\*" "$f"); printf '{"four_neg":%s,"one_pos":%s,"four_bad":%s,"bullets":%s}' "$four_neg" "$one_pos" "$four_bad" "$bullets"
